<ic>To build in Holburg a cemetery for the Marchers raised as husks.<br><br>

''Proposed by Temeschwar, seconded by Semmerholm.''</ic>

===Overview===
* A Marcher graveyard involves importing soil from [[the Marches]] and planting Marcher apple trees.
* No funds were requested

===Date===
* Spring Equinox 378YE

===Cost===
* None

===Progress===
* Completed. The graveyard was quickly completed in [[Holberg#Holfried|Holfried]].
